title: Chapter 26 Surrounding Situation
content:
Chapter 26 Surrounding Situation

After pacifying the two tribes of Mengla and Aisen, there should be no one in the surrounding twenty miles that could threaten him. All the tribes were destroyed by himself, and no one escaped.

Then, the news of a 20-mile area united by a tribe of yellow-skinned people should not be spread within ten days.

Among the barbarian tribes that are savage and backward and full of bloody thoughts, the concept of territory is very important, because territory represents food, and food is related to the survival of a tribe.

Therefore, for anyone who is not from this tribe, who rashly breaks into the territory of his own tribe, unless he is a messenger sent by his own alliance, he can be executed on the spot regardless of the situation.

Therefore, under such circumstances and customs, all barbarians dare not rush to other people's tribes, so as not to cause disputes, lose their lives in vain, or even cause wars between the two tribes, for no reason. to get into this trouble.

With this premise, Zhong Yu naturally unified the surrounding plains and put on the best layer of veil. Let him have more time and add more strength to resist the next crazy counterattack of the Eddra Tribal Alliance.

Communication between barbarians, pitiful, is better now. At least, at the beginning of each year, all tribal leaders must go to the main headquarters of the tribal alliance for a meeting.

Or a different kind of allegiance, allegiance to the leader of the tribal alliance, expressing one's loyalty, and on this basis, discuss how to fight against the other two large forces in the new year!

In other cases, in addition to the messengers of the Alliance Leader, no one can freely go to the territories of other Alliance tribes. This is also a measure taken by the leader of the alliance to prevent other tribal chains from concatenating and seizing his own authority.

So he supports and encourages this custom very much. In this case, all tribes maintained greater autonomy.

However, because of the lack of information and lack of communication, they stayed at a very backward level of civilization. Except for their considerable military advantage, nowhere else could they compare to the other two major forces.

The only reason why it can keep it and continue to survive, in addition to the other two major forces that need a buffer, check and balance, is because within this alliance, because the tribe has considerable autonomy, and the warrior with a very high will to fight. .

These warriors deeply understand that they are not fighting for the lord of the alliance, but for the survival of their own tribe.

They cannot lose. Once they lose, their tribe will be destroyed and become slaves of the other two forces, tortured and humiliated by them in every possible way.

Therefore, when all the tribes who knew this fact were in war, they all fought in full force, and their combat effectiveness exceeded the table, which made the other two major forces very jealous and did not dare to persecute them too much.

Therefore, this tribal alliance exists as a very backward and closed force, but it still exists as the third largest force in the Lost Plain.

As a result, after obtaining the surrender of all the leaders of the Mengla tribe, Zhong Yu knew the approximate force on the plain, the area where he was located, and the special habits of this force.

A trace of greed and endless ambition appeared uncontrollably in my heart. In such a backward and closed place, there is no point of communication and construction of roads.

This Eddra Tribal Alliance, this is not the best stepping stone to give yourself the best resource to enable yourself to rise from the lost land.

As long as he can silently suck his marrow and devour his essence on his body, quietly, he can become the fourth largest force in this plain.

The traffic with them is blocked, and it can also absorb the news of its essence for himself, that is, annexing the small tribes under his alliance, there is enough time to buffer, and it is not known by all the big forces.

It just so happened that after their resistance and their own slaughter, the population of the Aisen tribe was only fifty or sixty. Even if the Mengla tribe was added, it was only one hundred, seventy or eighty.

For himself, who is in urgent need of population upgrade, the territory is still too scarce to provide enough impetus for his rapid development.

There are 1,000 households and a population of 5,000 people living in the upgraded territory, and there is still a gap of about 2,400 people. It is in this backward place, through the inconvenience of transportation, to cover up and swallow the news of those small tribes.

Confirmation with the chief elder through the conversation with the high priest of the Mong La tribe. Zhong Yu preliminarily determined that the territory of this Edra Tribal Alliance is about the size of five or six prefecture-level cities in the previous life.

The population is about 250,000 to 60,000. Although it is a little less than the more than 300,000 of the other two major forces, it is enough for this force to survive in this plain.

And his position is right at the end of the Edra Tribal Alliance. He is not connected to any forces. There is an endless forest behind him, and no one can cross it. If you rush into this forest, you will only get lost in the endless emerald green and can't find your way.

Therefore, the Edra Alliance is very reassured about their own rear. They firmly believe that no one can pass through the jungle and attack their rear. The endless creatures will teach them to understand that this is not broadcast by mortals. restricted area.

In addition to this being the rear, he is also the most backward place for the man he loves. In a relatively safe environment, the long-term comfortable life makes them lose the motivation to move forward.

Only need to hunt, can continue the survival of the tribe, so that they lose their desire for territory, so they reject all foreign things, stick to their own traditions.

Except for the call of the Alliance Leaders, they never go out, so they guard the territory of their own tribes, prohibiting anyone from approaching their tribes, so as to ensure the purity and safety of their tribes.

And this is exactly what Zhong Yu wanted to see. The further behind they are, the weaker their resistance will be. The more you deny the entry of outsiders and prohibit all communication, the longer you can hide the news of your own annexation of them.

Zhong Yu believed that even if he annexed the 50,000-60,000 population of this alliance, 1/3, or 1/4 of the territory. At that time, it may be that the entire alliance will suddenly realize that such a behemoth has risen unknowingly behind him.

And this buffer time, as long as you are fast enough and covert enough, and don't let anyone from the tribe go to report the news, then, this period of time is enough to last it for more than half a year.

It was not until all the tribes of the alliance were called up by the leader of the alliance that they were about to participate in the annual meeting of the tribal alliance, and the messengers constantly wandered between the tribes, colluding, and others discovered the abnormality behind them.

At that time, he had already become the leader of a force with a population of tens of thousands and possibly tens of thousands of troops. According to the rules of the system, the head of 1,000 households with 5,000 people has 100 luck points every month, which can be exchanged for soldiers, and can be exchanged for 200 ordinary soldiers. These have been trained for a long time and have been in one or two. In the second battlefield, I saw some bloody veterans.

And if there are tens of thousands of households and 50,000 people, then 1,000 Qi Luck Points can be produced in a month, which can be exchanged for 2,000 ordinary soldiers. Of course, Zhong Yu can't have 50,000 people all at once. This is a slow A slow accumulation process.

However, in half a year, it was enough for him to exchange thousands of ordinary soldiers, plus several lottery draws, and the slave army formed by conquering those tribes, how could he be able to have 10,000 or 20,000 soldiers and horses.

At that time, with their trained and well-armed soldiers as the foundation and those tribal servants as the wings, they will be able to form an extremely powerful army. Even if he is allied with the Edra tribe, and fights his arms and fights, Zhong Yu will not show his cowardice.
